verdict.reasons: Core rejection triggered due to product family mismatch: the installed lateral lines are rendered as thick, rigid pipes (hose profile) rather than the thin, flattened polyethylene drip tape characteristic of the target 'tape20' family. While the carton's branding (AFP) is authentic, the blue band at the base of the carton is distorted and lacks the standard vertical ribbed texture of the approved reference. Secondary minor deductions include small seedlings present between the drip lines, which slightly detracts from the strict 'neutral seedlings' evidence requirement, and secondary text on the carton face (e.g., 'Drip Irrigation Tape') is slightly misaligned or non-standard compared to the approved guide.

acceptance_decision.source: user requested practical >=90 acceptance; actual saved vision evidence retained
